names.details: Cebel-i ʿAmmāre: It is a mountain in the land of ʿUdva. It overlooks the sea, and only God knows the number of the nations upon it. When the Strait Sea (Baḥr-i Zuḳāḳ, i.e., the Strait of Gibraltar) extends toward Ceuta (Sebte), it becomes contiguous with a city called Bārīs, and the distance between the two is one hundred miles. And opposite Bārīs, on the Andalusian side, lies Málaga (Malaġa). [translation]
